audit.whatIsWrong: The chart read Jayce/Skill/Singed/Singed/Jayce/Singed/Singed while the page's own prose says 'Jayce owns you levels 1 through 3', calls levels 4-5 'a proxy macro game, not a lane game', calls level 6 the Insanity Potion spike, and whys[3] explicitly calls the first-item row a 'genuine Skill window'. It handed Singed levels 3 and 4-5 in the window the text calls pure poke, and handed Jayce level 6 in the window the text calls Singed's spike.
audit.why: The mirror audits/top/jayce__singed.json has already been corrected to Jayce, Jayce, Jayce, Skill, Singed, Skill, Singed, and the packet chart is identical. Reused rather than re-derived.
audit.corrected: Sides set to Jayce, Jayce, Jayce, Skill, Singed, Skill, Singed in both layers as one atomic group, ratings inverted to match, and the five affected phase whys rewritten.

audit.whatIsWrong: Phase rows were template text with no Jayce cooldown anywhere and no statement of what Insanity Potion actually does at 6.
audit.why: His spikes are Shock Blast through the Gate from level 1-3, and his first item; yours are Insanity Potion at 6 (100s flat, stats plus Grievous Wounds on Poison Trail) and Rylai's.
audit.corrected: Level 6 now names Insanity Potion's 100s cooldown and the Grievous Wounds it puts on Poison Trail; the poke rows name Shock Blast (16s at rank 1) and Thundering Blow (20s at rank 1).

audit.whatIsWrong: whys[2] tells the reader 'your Mega Adhesive root is too easily dodged by his dash'. That is backwards: Mega Adhesive grounds, To the Skies! is Jayce's only dash, and his own kit file flags it as 'mobility that grounding and walls can deny' — from inside the goo the dash simply will not cast. The mirror already records grounding as the decisive fact of this matchup. The real reason the goo is hard to land is Thundering Blow's knockback, which is a different problem with a different answer (bait it first). Also missing: Fling's root is conditional on the goo already being down, and Hextech Capacitor gives Jayce move speed every time he swaps weapons, which is how he actually breaks your run-at.
audit.why: Riot Data Dragon descriptions for Jayce P/Q/E/R and Singed W/E, plus the corrected mirror.
audit.corrected: Grounding stated as what shuts To the Skies! off, Thundering Blow named as the thing that actually stops the goo landing, the Fling-into-goo root stated as conditional, and Hextech Capacitor written in.

audit.whatIsWrong: Not one cooldown on either side appeared on the page, and wants.foe[2] claims Jayce wants to 'maintain cannon stance at all times', which misreads his kit — the stance swap is a 6-second cooldown, so he is never locked into a form and can always be back in cannon when you break off.
audit.why: Shock Blast / To the Skies! is 16/14/12/10/8/6, Thundering Blow / Acceleration Gate 20/18/16/14/12/10, the Mercury Cannon-Hammer swap 6 flat; Singed's Mega Adhesive is 17/16/15/14/13, Fling 10/9.5/9/8.5/8, Insanity Potion 100.
audit.corrected: Real numbers written into the phase whys, cooldown block, dos/donts and spikes, and the stance claim replaced with the 6-second swap.

audit.whatIsWrong: The weapon swap is an auto-attack reset and nothing on the page said so — the first attack after a swap also shreds armour and magic resist (into cannon) or adds magic damage (into hammer), so the swap animation, not an ability cast, is the burst tell.
audit.why: Riot flags Mercury Cannon / Mercury Hammer with autoReset and describes the first-attack bonus in both directions; the _missing file carries the same rule for this pairing.
audit.corrected: The 6-second swap written in as an auto reset in the interactions row.

edits.before: Jayce owns you levels 1 through 3 with one tool: Shock Blast through Acceleration Gate from a range your Poison Trail cannot reach. Do not walk up and trail; you are not a trading champion in this window. Instead set up the wave to bounce near your tower by last-hitting at Q range, accept a poke deficit, and identify his Acceleration Gate placement so you can arc around it. The moment he wastes a Shock Blast on a minion or misjudges your pathing, that is your only early window — but even then, only commit if he is in melee form and Thundering Blow is on cooldown.
edits.after: Jayce owns you levels 1 through 3 with one tool: Shock Blast through Acceleration Gate from a range your Poison Trail cannot reach. Do not walk up and trail; you are not a trading champion in this window. Instead set up the wave to bounce near your tower by last-hitting at Q range, accept a poke deficit, and identify his Acceleration Gate placement so you can arc around it. The moment he wastes a Shock Blast on a minion or misjudges your pathing, that is your only early window — but even then, only commit if he is in hammer form and Thundering Blow (20s) is down.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 are a proxy macro game, not a lane game. Ghost and run behind his tower to farm the caster wave before it reaches him; Jayce has no reliable way to punish a proxying Singed who has Ghost up, and every wave he has to clear under tower is gold you take for free. At level 6, Insanity Potion finally gives you the stats to run at him in close range — bait a Thundering Blow by walking in at an angle, let it land, then immediately Mega Adhesive the ground so he cannot dash back, Fling him into your Poison Trail cloud, and keep running. He has no hard CC to end your chase and your regeneration eats his follow-up poke.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 are a proxy macro game, not a lane game. Ghost and run behind his tower to farm the caster wave before it reaches him; Jayce has no reliable way to punish a proxying Singed who has Ghost up, and every wave he has to clear under tower is gold you take for free. At level 6, Insanity Potion finally gives you the stats to run at him in close range — bait a Thundering Blow by walking in at an angle, let it land, then Mega Adhesive his feet — grounded, To the Skies! will not cast, Fling him into the goo so the landing roots him, and keep running. He has no hard CC to end your chase and your regeneration eats his follow-up poke.

notes: Mirror reused: audits/top/jayce__singed.json had already corrected this chart to Jayce, Jayce, Jayce, Skill, Singed, Skill, Singed and the packet agrees, so I adopted it verbatim rather than re-deriving, and inverted the ratings. Same class of error as the Irelia page: whys[2] told the reader Mega Adhesive is 'too easily dodged by his dash' when grounding means To the Skies! cannot be cast from inside the goo at all — the mirror flags grounding as the decisive fact from Jayce's side too, so the two pages were contradicting each other. Left diffRating at 7.5/10: the mirror did not change Jayce's rating, and inverting only my side would introduce a fresh disagreement for tools/mirror-fix.js to clean up.
